text: Cattle fed only on rice straw during the dry season lose condition and produce less milk or slower weight gain, because rice straw alone is low in protein and digestibility. Supplementing with para grass, legume forage, or a small amount of concentrate feed during the dry season substantially improves growth and reproduction. Only registered, quality-checked feed products should be used; unregistered feeds and additives are more likely to contain unsafe or banned substances that can harm animal health and, ultimately, food safety for consumers.
